text: Epic fantasy scene: A divine angelic woman with long black hair and radiant white wings, wearing a golden halo and ornate silver armor, gently places her glowing hand on the shoulder of a grim warrior-skeleton. The skeleton knight wears heavy black plate armor adorned with gold detailing, red velvet undergarments stained with blood, and wields a massive ornate shield in one hand and a gleaming sword in the other. His skull face is serene yet menacing, eyes hollow but wise — a fallen hero or death incarnate. Behind them, divine light bursts from heaven, illuminating swirling clouds and ancient ruins. The angel’s expression is tender, compassionate, as if offering redemption or final blessing. The atmosphere is dramatic, cinematic, with high contrast lighting: ethereal glow around the angel vs. dark shadows on the knight. Style: hyperrealistic digital painting, fantasy art, inspired by ArtStation and Blizzard/Studio Ghibli meets Game of Thrones aesthetics — rich textures, dynamic composition, emotional depth. Color palette: golds, whites, deep blacks, crimson reds.
